clinical_reasoning_summary: The patient’s profile of obesity, prediabetes, and hypertension aligns most closely with metabolic syndrome, which unifies the observed cardiovascular risk factors. Untreated obstructive sleep apnea further aggravates hypertension and metabolic dysfunction. While resistant hypertension is plausible, confirmation requires ambulatory monitoring. Early CKD and anemia are possible comorbidities but lack definitive laboratory confirmation at this time.
